title: Add Deposit needs both permissions, also checked when saving
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • A customer to sell to exists.
  • A part sale in Estimate, Approved or Complete status, for the customer, with a part (for example "Brake Pads"; Quantity 1; Sell Price for example $290.91).
  • Two spare test users: one with the role "ZZAUTOTEST No part sale edit" (Part sales - Create & Edit unticked) and one with the role "ZZAUTOTEST No invoicing edit" (Invoicing & payments - Create & Edit unticked), both built from a template (for example "Parts Manager").
  • Sign in as an Owner/Admin user to build the sale.
custom_steps:
1. As a user missing either permission, open the Finance tab and look for Add Deposit.
  2. As the user without Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit, attempt a deposit and confirm the server refuses it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A user without either permission is not offered Add Deposit; a user without Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit is refused by the server as well, as on a work order.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N2: “A user without either permission above is not offered Add Deposit. A user without Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit is refused by the server as well, as on a work order”
